name.la: Orationes de passione Domini et beata virgine et aliis sanctis
name.en-US: Prayers on the Passion of the Lord, the Blessed Virgin and Other Saints
name.pt-BR: Orações sobre a Paixão do Senhor, a Virgem Santíssima e outros santos

description.la: Orationes Thomae a Kempis de passione Domini, de beata virgine Maria et de aliis sanctis (Ioanne Baptista et Evangelista, Thoma apostolo, Maria Magdalena, Agnete), in quibus gratias agit, compatitur et suffragia petit.
description.en-US: Sixteen prayers: on the Passion of the Lord (to the Father at Mass, of remembrance and imitation, of compassion, to Christ, of thanksgiving), to the Blessed Virgin (love and praise, help at the hour of death, special consolation, in tribulation), and to other saints (John the Baptist, John the Evangelist, Thomas the Apostle, Mary Magdalene, Agnes). Latin only: Pohl's edition (Freiburg 1904), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Dezesseis orações: sobre a Paixão do Senhor, à Virgem Santíssima (amor e louvor, auxílio na hora da morte, consolação, nas tribulações) e a outros santos (João Batista, João Evangelista, Tomé apóstolo, Maria Madalena, Inês).

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Orationes de passione Domini et beata virgine et aliis sanctis, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1904), Opera omnia III; archive.org raw OCR.
sources.description: The prayers as Pohl numbers them, in three groups. Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical apparatus and introduction not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals garbled and some slips remain after the scripted lexicon repair.
